name: London Fix Pressure Reversal
hypothesis: Price pressure from pre-hedging into the 16:00 London fix (15:00-16:15 London move >=0.25 daily ATR) reverses after the fix window.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; stop beyond the 15:00-16:15 extreme plus 0.2 M15 ATR; 2.2R objective; 3-hour limit or next broker gap.
known_limitations: No verified edge. M15 both-barrier candles need M1 (only since Jul 2026) and are otherwise AMBIGUOUS; CFD spread proxies; correlated instruments; broker holiday calendar unverified.
